text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Did my nosebleed stop, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why do I keep running into walls 
like this over and over...?
...Can you hear... Tannhau...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

Can you hear me... Matikanetannhauser...? 
I am calling out... directly to your 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa!? Wh-Wh-What is this!? Wh-Who are 
you!?
I am the God of Nosebleeds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The God of Nosebleeds!?

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text:
I have been summoned now that the total 
volume of your nosebleeds has reached a 
full bucket.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That much!? Then again, we did bump into 
each other a lot...

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is this... something to celebrate?

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text:
Of course. A nosebleed is proof that you 
ran full-tilt without fear of running into 
things, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I get it now!! Put that way, maybe 
nosebleeds aren't so bad after all!

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to run with everything 
you have. I'll be rooting for you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Was I asleep?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aw, it was just a dream~? I guess a 
nosebleed deity really was too weird to be 
true...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I guess a bloody nose is proof 
that I ran with everything I had...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I think I had a nice dream!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Machikane Tannhauser's 
running grew noticeably sharper.
